summary: On June 1, 2026, LEIFRAS Co., Ltd., a Japanese education-services firm, completed a stock transfer acquiring all issued and outstanding shares of Tokai Sports Co., Ltd. from two individual sellers. The transaction was all-cash, with consideration paid at closing; no price per share, premium, or implied value is disclosed. The acquisition was governed by a Stock Transfer Agreement dated May 20, 2026. LEIFRAS now operates the target's sports education businesses. No advisors or board recommendations are noted. The deal closed in under two weeks post-agreement. Watch for integration details and any subsequent earn-out or regulatory filings.
